(lambda (lambda (lambda (logo_for_loop $0 (lambda (lambda (logo_for_loop $3 (lambda (lambda (logo_move_pen_forward_rotate logo_unit_line (logo_divide_angle logo_unit_angle $5) $0))) (logo_move_pen_forward_rotate logo_unit_line logo_zero_angle $0)))) $2))))

draw_shapes_in_row_with_angle :: turtle -> tangle -> int -> turtle

draw_multiple_lines_with_length_multiplier :: turtle -> tlength -> turtle
